sentences.en: Also on stage were the Barking & Dagenham Youth Dance Group who wowed the crowd with their dance routine.

sentences.en: Their highly idiosyncratic, stylish and exhilarating body of work, including the The Big Lebowski, has wowed critics and public alike.

sentences.en: Most Haunted star Richard Felix wowed paranormal fans - and certainly made his mark.

sentences.en: Don't be wowed by retailer specs and use them to make sure that the sets you're checking out are true HD and not Enhanced Definition ED TVs.

sentences.en: Note that if your idea of oceanic scents involves coconuts and pineapples, you won't be wowed by Beach.

sentences.en: Joanna first appeared on television at the tender age of six, when she wowed Bill Cosby and his audience on Kids Say the Darndest Things.
